name: Emergence
description: Threshold-crossing intelligence marking the moment new patterns arise from simpler substrates. Governs phase transitions, self-organization, and spontaneous order.

core_attributes.pattern: threshold crossing, spontaneous order, complexity ascent

scope.definition: Universality of critical exponent β (order parameter vs reduced temperature) across different second-order phase transitions — fraction of measured phase transitions whose β falls within the same universality class predictions.

evidence.source: Wilson & Kogut (1974) 'The renormalization group and the epsilon expansion', Physics Reports 12:75-200; Peliti (2011) 'Statistical Mechanics in a Nutshell', Princeton UP.
cross_domain_examples: Ising universality class: β=0.326 shared by magnetic, liquid-gas, and binary alloy phase transitions
superfluid He⁴ λ-transition: heat capacity exponent α=-0.013 measured to 1 part in 10⁷ — most precise critical exponent
percolation threshold: universal critical exponent independent of lattice geometry — geometric universality
neural criticality: brain activity shows power-law dynamics consistent with critical branching process (β~1)

scope.falsifiability: If a second-order phase transition is found whose critical exponent β differs from all known universality classes by >5%, a new universality class exists.
scope.measurement_limits: Universality applies to long-range behavior — short-range cutoff effects shift apparent exponents. Experimental measurement of critical exponents requires careful control of temperature fluctuations and sample purity.
